{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the total number of loyal customers and converted loyal customers
total_loyal = len(df_loyal)
converted_loyal = df_loyal['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate_loyal = converted_loyal / total_loyal

# Print all values used in evidence
print(f"total_loyal = {total_loyal}")
print(f"converted_loyal = {converted_loyal}")
print(f"conversion_rate_loyal = {conversion_rate_loyal}")"}
